thread:
Noah: Pushed a near-final launch blog draft to Drive (https://drive.redwood.ai/s/launch-final). Need 1) embargo window confirm 2) A/B CTA split for blog (webinar vs trial) 3) HS form names + pixel. Can we lock by EOD?

Elaine: Skimming now. Can we A/B test CTA copy too? i.e., 'Save your seat' vs 'Register for the live demo' for the webinar path.

Marco: Bench snippet to include: 'p95 latency ~ -21% vs baseline; median cost per 1k tokens down ~16%'. Legal wants the exact phrasing and footnote.

Sophie: From design: we have a GIF demo and 3 hero variants. Suggest run hero variants as 50/25/25 split. GIF needs alt text and a 1200x628 static fallback.

Devon: Ops ask: what's the embargo time? We need final copy + assets 6 hours before publish to stage the landing page and CDN. Also confirm webinar seating cap and overflow plan.

Noah: Embargo: publish embargo lifted 2pm PT next Wednesday. Assets by 8am PT same day to give ops runway. Webinar cap 400 live seats; overflow -> recording + two office hours.

Riley: HubSpot forms: I'll create two forms: 'launch_webinar_ab' and 'launch_api_trial_ab'. For A/B we'll add a hidden field 'cta_variant' with values 'webinar_A'/'webinar_B'. Pixel: add tracking pixel id PX-7721.

Marco: Legal: numeric claims ok with qualifier. Exact footnote to include: "Benchmarks measured on Redwood internal harness; your workload may vary." Please add inline reference after numbers.

Elaine: A/B copy recommendation: Webinar A: 'Save your seat' (short, playful). Webinar B: 'Register for the live demo' (explicit). Trial A: 'Start free API trial' vs Trial B: 'Create your free API key'. Which aligns with paid funnel?

Noah: Growth prefers explicit CTAs for enterprise—so Webinar B + Trial B as primary. We can still run A as 30% test. Please set weights: primary 70% (B), variant A 30%.

Devon: Ops confirmed staging window. Will stage landing + forms at 8:30am PT and do a dry-run at 11:30am PT. I'll also enable CDN purge hooks for the hero image.

Riley: Done — HS forms created and zaps set. Pixel installed on staging preview. Forms have thank-you redirects to /thanks?src=blog_ab and include the hidden cta_variant.

Sophie: Uploaded GIF + 3 hero PNGs to Drive (2x assets). Added alt text drafts. Leaving a comment about mobile hero cropping.

Noah: Final approvers: Elaine (voice), Marco (legal), Riley (tracking), Devon (ops), Sophie (design). Reply 'LGTM' or flag by 4pm PT.

Elaine: LGTM with tiny tweak: remove "we're thrilled" in intro -> use "today we announce".

Marco: LGTM legal. Confirm footnote text present.

Riley: LGTM tracking. Pixel live on staging.

Devon: LGTM ops. Staging schedule locked.

Sophie: LGTM design. Uploaded mobile crop suggestions.

Ops-Bot: deploy-preview-1 created: https://preview.redwood.ai/launch?v=pr1 (expires in 48h).

Noah: Great work team. I'll wire CTAs in the doc and hand to growth once preview URL is green. Thanks :)
